sloka: रावणस्तु महावीर्यो निषण्णः शैलमूर्धनि ।स ददर्श गुणांस्तत्र चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् ।। ७.२६.३ ॥
transliteration: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryo niṣaṇṇaḥ śailamūrdhani ।sa dadarśa guṇāṁstatra candrapādapaśobhitān ।। 7.26.3 ॥

translations.english: But the mighty Ravana, seated on the mountain peak, beheld the beautiful features of that place, enhanced by trees illuminated by the moonlight.
